skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the general theories of international trade law, including subjects, sources, principles, and institutions involved in international trade activities.
Understand and apply the laws governing international trade in goods, services, and intellectual property.

Understand and apply the legal framework governing international trade contracts, including international sales contracts, international transport contracts, and international marine cargo insurance contracts.
Understand and apply the legal framework governing international payments.
Understand and apply the legal framework governing the resolution of international trade disputes.
Apply legal research skills to analyze and solve legal issues in international trade.
Demonstrate effective communication skills, including presentation and negotiation skills.
Analyze and synthesize information from legal scenarios in international trade.
Apply legal provisions to solve specific legal issues in international trade scenarios.
Develop self-directed learning skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge.
Develop planning and implementation skills to propose innovative solutions.
